description: This file declares the SecondaryCommandBuffer class, which is a specialized class for managing Vulkan secondary command buffers within the Cuttlefish project. It includes method declarations for lifecycle management, swapchain dependency handling, and frame recording, along with private members related to Vulkan objects such as render passes, framebuffers, shaders, and pipelines.

classes.name: SecondaryCommandBuffer
classes.description: A class managing Vulkan secondary command buffers, inheriting from SampleBase, providing methods for initialization, cleanup, swapchain management, and frame recording.

methods.description: Initializes resources needed for the command buffer.

methods.name: CleanUp
methods.description: Releases resources held by the command buffer.

methods.description: Creates Vulkan objects dependent on the swapchain.

methods.name: DestroySwapchainDependents
methods.description: Destroys Vulkan objects dependent on the swapchain.
